messages.operator: GLOBAL HALAL SUPPLY CHAIN LIMITED · HONG KONG
messages.boundary: AI assists. Humans decide. AHTE is evidence and decision-support infrastructure. Formal certification remains with JAKIM / MAIN / JAIN; destination acceptance remains with the competent GCC authorities and importers.
messages.architecture: Designed architecture · external connections require authorized activation
messages.principle: Data stays where it belongs. Trust travels.

pages.label: The ecosystem
pages.title: Distinct roles. One accountable trust chain.
pages.description: Malaysian institutional capability, GHSCL international operations and AHTE digital trust connect China origin to GCC destination. Authorities remain independently identifiable.

sections.title: Who does what
cards: PHC

Perak Halal Corporation is the Perak State Government halal-industry GLC in the project model, serving local and international industry development. The proposed institutional workflow includes PHC coordination with authorized human authority actors; it does not grant PHC independent certification powers.
GHSCL HK

Global Halal Supply Chain Limited Hong Kong is the international operating and digital-infrastructure vehicle connecting the Malaysian institutional layer, China participants and GCC destination interfaces. JV ownership terms require supporting corporate instruments.
AHTE

The Amanah Halal Trust Ecosystem links standards intelligence, applicability, evidence, audits, digital twins, monitoring, integrity, trust state and exception orchestration. It does not act as the certification authority.
JAKIM / MAIN / JAIN

Competent Malaysian certification authorities retain decisions within their mandates. Mufti, scholars and designated human reviewers participate only within an evidenced, authorized decision workflow.
China origin ecosystem

Sources, producers, suppliers, manufacturers, laboratories, warehouses, logistics and ports contribute purpose-bound evidence. Exact laboratory identity, accreditation and recognition are separate validation objects.
GCC destination ecosystem
Authorities, customs, importers, receiving warehouses, distributors, retailers and buyers apply destination controls. Origin assurance does not guarantee destination acceptance.

sections.title: Authority connectivity is an interface
sections.text: JAKIM is connected through a secure Authority Gateway, alongside independent operational participants. The diagram describes exchange boundaries, not corporate ownership or a currently connected official API.
sections.detail: The gateway boundary covers authenticated exchange, schema validation, case correlation, integrity verification, retry/idempotency, audit logs and signed status updates. Official endpoint, authentication, mandate and data contract remain source-locked.

sections.title: Approval and disapproval remain human decisions
sections.text: The designed workflow routes a complete audit and evidence dossier to authorized human decision-makers. Approval, disapproval, conditions, expiry, suspension and withdrawal must originate from an authenticated authority record; a platform score cannot manufacture that record.
sections.detail: The handoff requests a PHC/JAKIM Mufti/scholar certification workflow. The canonical partner registry assigns PHC a commercial industry role and explicitly reserves official certification to JAKIM/MAIN/JAIN. That mandate conflict is recorded in CLAIMS_AND_GATES_2026-09-30.json and remains open.

pages.label: How it works
pages.title: Trace the origin. Inspect the evidence. Gate every release.
pages.description: A complete operating lifecycle begins before manufacturing and continues through laboratory evidence, audit, human authority decisions, custody and destination verification.

sections.title: Before the factory
sections.text: Register source identity, material, lot, origin documents and applicable requirements before production. A sample remains bound to its material and collection history; a signed result without reconciled custody is insufficient.

sections.title: Within the operation
sections.text: The facility twin connects zones, people, materials, processes and batches to the controls that require evidence. Supplier, formula or process changes trigger review of affected objects.

sections.title: Human authority and continuing monitoring
sections.text: Authority decisions and system trust states are distinct. Approval conditions and validity remain attached to the decision scope. A later exception can require HOLD, re-verification or recall without rewriting the original evidence.

sections.title: From factory to market
sections.text: Each physical handoff has identity, custody, condition and document checks. Destination acceptance and internal operational release remain separately evidenced gates.

sections.title: Laboratory evidence is a native workflow
sections.text: A laboratory connector carries accession, method scope, matrix, result, signatory, report version and correction history. Uploading a PDF alone does not establish authenticated laboratory evidence. NOT DETECTED ≠ HALAL.

sections.title: Requirements are resolved by scope
sections.text: The standards architecture includes the project’s seventeen Malaysian Standards, alongside applicable MPPHM, MHMS, Meat & Poultry protocols, JAKIM circulars and destination instruments. Entity, product, process, activity, market and shipment determine applicability. Licensed clause text is not reproduced.

pages.label: AHTE digital trust
pages.title: Physical operations. Connected evidence. Accountable state.
pages.description: AHTE combines standards intelligence, evidence graphs, digital twins, cryptographic integrity, AI assistance and authority-connected trust orchestration.

sections.title: The intelligence layers
cards: Standards and applicability
Resolve authoritative instrument, version, requirement and applicability before choosing controls. Missing licensed text remains source-locked.
Evidence intelligence
Bind source records, actors, devices, timestamps, custody and integrity proofs to the exact object and control.
AI assurance
Surface gaps, anomalies, contradictions, changes and potential trust fractures. Preserve evidence references and model/version provenance for human review.
Digital twins
Facility, material, sample, batch, lot, pallet, shipment, container and seal objects carry identity, events, relationships and evidence. A render alone is not a live twin.

sections.title: Integrity protects history; it does not create truth
sections.text: A hash detects alteration relative to a known digest after creation. It does not independently prove the source claim. Trust also depends on verified source, authenticated actor, custody, scope and accountable review. Blockchain is an optional integrity anchor, not the authority root.
sections.detail: Corrections create a new version plus an authorized supersession event, reason and new integrity proof. Original media and historical records remain preserved. Signature checks also require trusted keys, validity and revocation checks.

sections.title: Three different views of status
cards: System trust state
Object-scoped evidence and control state: incomplete, assessed, HOLD, corrective action, re-verification, quarantine or recall as applicable.
Formal certification state
An external competent-authority decision with issuer, mandate, scope, validity, conditions and authenticated evidence. It is never inferred from a hash or AI score.
Operational release
A separate internal gate after required controls and destination conditions pass. It cannot replace certification or import clearance.
sections.detail: Conceptual uppercase lifecycle terms in the China execution model are not a new executable enum. The pinned canonical authority_decided machine state has no onward transition. Source governance must resolve vocabulary and transition conflicts before promotion.

sections.title: Exceptions travel with their affected objects
sections.text: Event ingestion, rules, geofencing and anomaly detection can identify expired evidence, custody breaks, seal mismatch, HCP/SCCP deviations, temperature excursions or destination rejection. The response is HOLD, scoped impact analysis, human review and re-verification—not a compensated aggregate score.
sections.detail: Examples include LAB_RESULT_LINKED, SUPPLIER_CHANGED, HCP_EXCEPTION, SEAL_APPLIED, ROUTE_DEVIATION, DESTINATION_RECEIVED and AUTHORITY_STATUS_UPDATED. These are architecture examples; connector event mapping must match its approved source contract.

sections.title: Replaceable connectors. Explicit trust boundaries.
cards: Authority Gateway
Official authority references, signed decisions, case/status synchronization and revocation. No official JAKIM endpoint is invented.
LabConnector
Sample, accession, method, result, custody, authenticated evidence and amendment/versioning.
LogisticsConnector
Booking, container, seal, custody, condition, geofence, exception and receiving events.
Factory connectors
ERP, MES, QMS, WMS, LIMS and IoT adapters exchange stable IDs, source versions, timestamps and integrity metadata.

sections.title: Federation with selective disclosure
sections.text: Detailed records stay within their governed source domains. Cross-border exchange uses authorized assertions, references, hashes, status and minimum necessary metadata. Manufacturer, auditor, authority, lab, importer and consumer views follow role, organization and purpose boundaries.
sections.detail: Security architecture includes MFA, least privilege, RBAC/ABAC where applicable, encrypted transport/storage, device identity, protected keys, revocation, replay prevention, idempotency and append-only audit history. Connector health and processing errors should be observable without logging sensitive payloads.

pages.label: End-to-end traceability
pages.title: From raw-material origin to the authorized market view.
pages.description: Four synchronized chains connect physical movement, identity and custody, evidence, and authority-linked trust. Traceability starts before manufacturing.

sections.title: Origin and production genealogy
sections.text: Source → producer → supplier → material lot → sample → laboratory evidence → manufacturing batch → packaging lot. Each edge can carry evidence. A formula or supplier change identifies affected batches rather than erasing earlier lineage.

sections.title: Custody follows the physical object
sections.text: Container and seal identity, actor, timestamp, condition and acceptance bind each handover. GPS, geofence, temperature, humidity, door and tamper signals are selected by commodity risk; every sensor is not mandatory for every product.

sections.title: A physical event needs a digital binding
sections.text: Facility ↔ FacilityTwin; material ↔ MaterialObject; batch ↔ BatchObject; sample ↔ SampleObject; container ↔ ContainerObject; seal ↔ SealObject; handover ↔ CustodyTransferEvent; recall ↔ RecallCase.
sections.detail: ObjectID + EventID + EvidenceID + ActorID + Timestamp + IntegrityProof. Source system, control, requirement, device and relationship references add the context necessary to assess the event.

sections.title: Traceability without unrestricted disclosure
cards: Consumer / buyer
An issuer-authorized provenance, state and verification summary; no confidential formula or unrestricted supplier dossier.
Manufacturer / supplier
Own organization and scoped operational/evidence records.
Auditor / authority
Assigned evidence and regulatory scope with attributable access.
Importer / logistics / retail
Relevant shipment, custody, condition, receiving and destination records.

pages.label: Smart-glass AI audit
pages.title: At the physical site. Bound to the evidence.
pages.description: A requirement-guided wearable audit links object identification, observation, AI assistance, human assessment, findings and re-verification.

sections.title: The complete audit session
sections.text: AI may highlight missing evidence, anomalies, contradictions, possible duplication and control relevance. The auditor owns the finding. Formal certification remains with the competent authority.

sections.title: Identity precedes the device interaction
cards: Capture
Camera, still/video, microphone and dictated notes; QR, barcode, DataMatrix and OCR. NFC and location only where approved.
Trust
Device certificate, secure clock, role/scope permissions, auditor identity, MFA and hardware-backed keys where available.
Offline
Encrypted local storage, assigned signed requirement snapshot, local evidence hashing, queue and credential expiry/revocation cache.
Reconciliation
Server validation, event sequence, signature and replay checks, commit and acknowledgement. Conflicts are surfaced; originals are preserved.

sections.title: One observation, an attributable evidence object
sections.text: Capture context, identifier and observed condition. Original media remains immutable; annotations are separate linked objects.
sections.detail: EvidenceID, ObjectID, AuditID, RequirementID, HCPID, ActorID, Timestamp, DeviceID, LocationID where appropriate, MediaHash, SourceType, Description and IntegrityProof. Sync state and evidence type belong to the adapter contract.

sections.title: Designed for a real facility
sections.text: Authorized packages load only audit-relevant data. Factory PPE and safety rules govern device use. The session supports pause/lock and avoids distracting overlays around hazardous machinery.

pages.label: China → GCC
pages.title: A pilot corridor within a global architecture.
pages.description: China origin, Malaysian governance and GCC destination exchange controlled assertions across manufacturer, lab, logistics, port, importer and retail interfaces.

sections.title: Three jurisdictional planes
cards: China origin
Source, supplier, factory, lab, warehouse, smart audit, logistics and export operations retain governed source records.
Malaysia assurance
Applicable standards, institutional coordination, human review and competent-authority decision references.
GCC destination
Destination rules, customs, importers, receiving, warehouse, distribution, retail and authorized verification.

sections.title: Every handoff needs its own evidence
sections.text: The project designates Sinotrans for logistics and warehouse integration. Lane, carrier, named yard, qualification, contractual scope and receiving acceptance remain transaction-specific gates.

sections.title: Shipment 001: proof-of-operation plan
sections.text: [PILOT: Shipment 001 — China → GCC]. No completed shipment, bill of lading, live sensor stream or authority outcome is claimed. The reference playbook is a rehearsal and execution design, not a production record.

sections.title: Designed beyond the first shipment
sections.text: Collections of manufacturers, facilities, products, materials, audits, shipments, jurisdictions and connectors remain extensible. Shipment 001 must not become a fixed application limit or be promoted into general doctrine without review.

pages.label: Partners and institutions
pages.title: Connected participants. Evidenced mandates.
pages.description: Institutional, operating and technical roles remain distinct. A project-designated role or reported MoU is not proof of operational deployment, equity or certification authority.

sections.title: Project-designated roles
cards: PHC
Malaysian state halal-industry institutional layer. Registry status: reported nonbinding instrument; exact mandate and executed operating scope remain open.
GHSCL HK
International operating vehicle and trust/trade orchestration. No corporate ownership is inferred for external authorities.
Sinotrans
Logistics and warehouse participant. Registry status: reported nonbinding instruments; facility, route, qualification and transaction contracts remain open.
CODA
Institutional introductions, enterprise mobilization and qualification. Registry status: draft/proposed; no funding or authority promise.
NICFS / laboratory participants
Origin identity and scientific evidence within documented scope. Exact legal identities are not assumed to be aliases; laboratory recognition and method scope require separate evidence.
GCC importers / retail
Receiving, listing, distribution and destination execution. Named retailer entries are draft/proposed pathways, not claimed commercial deployments.

sections.title: An integration is more than a logo
sections.text: Before a production pilot, establish legal entity, authorized representative, scope, data ownership, evidence responsibility, security, service levels, incident escalation, commercial terms, confidentiality and transition arrangements.
sections.detail: Project partner registry 2.1.0, control date 2026-09-27, distinguishes project_designated_role from contractual_status. Evidence classes identify eligible evidence types; they do not prove received evidence or authority status.

pages.label: For manufacturers
pages.title: Prepare the operation. Build the evidence. Enter the trust chain.
pages.description: Manufacturer onboarding connects legal entity, facility, products, BOM, materials, suppliers, systems, evidence, audit and authority workflow to ongoing monitoring.

sections.title: A dossier that stays useful after the audit
cards: Readiness
Identify missing source, control, personnel and evidence records before an audit.
Continuity
Connect supplier and formula changes to the affected batch and control context.
Market preparation
Reconcile packaging, lot, pallet, container, seal and destination interfaces without promising approval.
Accountability
Give manufacturers, laboratories, auditors and authorities their own attributable responsibilities.

sections.title: What to prepare
cards: Company and facility
Legal entity, licenses, responsible persons, site ownership, layout, zones, equipment and controlled flows.
Products and materials
SKU, formulation/BOM and process versions; ingredients, raw materials, suppliers, origin and existing certificate references.
People and controls
Halal roles, competence, training, HCP/SCCP mapping, sanitation/segregation and change control.
Systems and evidence
ERP/MES/QMS/WMS/LIMS/IoT inventory, SOPs, monitoring logs, sampling, lab records and audit history.

sections.title: The manufacturer lifecycle
sections.text: Enrollment is not certification. Final approval/disapproval is externally owned, and shipment enablement still requires applicable destination gates.

sections.title: What happens next
sections.text: Use the preparation checklist below to create a local readiness brief. It does not submit an application or upload factory records. A project representative must establish an authorized onboarding channel before collecting confidential material.

pages.label: Verify a trust record
pages.title: A scoped disclosure. A clear authority boundary.
pages.description: Use an issuer-authorized verification token to retrieve a scoped AHTE disclosure. A product identifier alone does not authorize access to confidential factory records.

sections.title: A view that matches the verifier
cards: Buyer / consumer
An authorized disclosure may summarize product, batch, origin, trust state, authority reference, destination and last update. Unissued fields remain undisclosed.
Authority / auditor
A deeper view requires authenticated role and assigned scope; public verification does not grant authority access.
Product / batch / shipment
Identifiers resolve through authorized records and token scope. No public identifier directory or unrestricted evidence search is introduced.
Integrity and status
The service returns the packet’s recorded content hash and state. Retrieval alone does not independently verify an issuer signature or certify the product.

sections.title: What the result means
sections.text: A successful response confirms that a current, non-revoked disclosure token resolved to its bound packet. System trust state, formal certification and operational release remain distinct. Missing or expired tokens do not prove that a product is non-halal.

pages.label: Contact and next steps
pages.title: Start with the right scope and the right evidence.
pages.description: Prepare a manufacturer, laboratory, logistics or institutional enquiry without exposing confidential evidence through an unverified collection channel.

sections.title: Choose the conversation
cards: Manufacturer
Entity, facility, product category, origin and target market; readiness and system inventory.
Laboratory
Exact legal identity, accreditation/method scope, accession and signed-evidence integration.
Logistics / warehouse
Named facility, route, custody, container/seal, risk-based telemetry and receiving interface.
Institution / authority
Mandate, authorized representatives, interface ownership and controlled decision/evidence exchange.

sections.title: A controlled contact channel
sections.text: No verified company email, telephone or address is published in the reviewed website source. The enquiry builder creates a local brief for your existing project contact; it does not send messages. Production enquiry delivery remains an explicit configuration gate.
